title.value: Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act
title.provenance: This act shall be known, and may be cited, as the Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act.

location.provenance: The PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA DO ENACT AS FOLLOWS:

pfas_definition.provenance: ÒPerfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substancesÓ or ÒPFASÓ means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.
